by
  intro n F a b hab hF
  have cF := hF.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => ∑ i, fderiv ℝ F x (Pi.single i 1) i) :=
    continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
      (continuous_apply i).comp (cF.clm_apply continuous_const)
  exact MeasureTheory.integral_divergence_of_hasFDerivAt_off_countable a b hab F (fderiv ℝ F) ∅
    Set.countable_empty hF.continuous.continuousOn
    (fun x _ => ((hF.differentiable one_ne_zero) x).hasFDerivAt)
    (hc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc)
